title: Ancillary dwelling: maximum one per site and maximum internal floor area per Table 2.8a
text: C2.8.1 An ancillary dwelling in accordance with Table 2.8a, provided that it: i. does not preclude the primary dwelling from meeting the maximum site cover and the minimum required private open space, soft landscaping, trees and deep soil area; and ii. complies with the following design elements as relevant: 2.2 Solar access and natural ventilation; 2.3 Parking; 2.5 Utilities; 3.1 Site cover; 3.2 Building height; 3.3 Street setbacks; 3.4 Lot boundary setbacks; 3.5 Site works and retaining walls; 3.6 Streetscape; 3.7 Access; 3.9 Solar access for adjoining sites; 3.10 Visual privacy. Table 2.8a Ancillary dwelling provisions: when provided on the same site as a Small Dwelling in accordance with C2.9.1 - maximum 1 per site, maximum internal floor area 70m2; all other primary dwellings - maximum 1 per site, maximum internal floor area 90m2.

replaces.note: 70m2 -> 90m2; 70m2 retained on the same site as a small dwelling
'behind the street setback line' replaced by compliance with 3.3

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Conditions (i) and (ii) are cross-references tested by those rules on the combined development. Table 2.8a note: provisions relate to the ancillary portion except 3.1, 3.4 and 3.9, assessed with the primary dwelling. Register ch3-038: 'one per site' where a grouped dwelling's site is its exclusive-use lot invites an ancillary dwelling on each grouped dwelling site; unclear whether intended.
